reconstructed_captions.54: He finishes gathering a large bundle of dry twigs for kindling.
reconstructed_captions.55: He walks over to a prepared fire pit area with the tinder and kindling.
reconstructed_captions.56: He places the feather stick he made earlier into the center of the fire pit.
reconstructed_captions.57: He carefully arranges the gathered twigs around the feather stick in a tepee formation.
reconstructed_captions.58: He takes out a ferro rod and a striker, preparing to ignite the tinder.
reconstructed_captions.59: He strikes the ferro rod, sending a shower of sparks onto the fine wood shavings of the feather stick.
